news.headline: MSCI adds Air Link Communications to Frontier Market Small Cap Index, removes Biafo Industries
news.summary: Per Business Recorder ('MSCI adds 1 Pakistani co to Frontier Market Small Cap Index') and Bloom Pakistan, citing a JS Global note published Aug 13, 2026 around 11:42am PKT: MSCI's August 2026 index review added Air Link Communications (PSX: AIRLINK) to the MSCI Frontier Market Small Cap Index and removed Biafo Industries (not a desk-universe ticker), bringing Pakistan's total constituent count in that index to 80 stocks; no change reported to the main MSCI Frontier Markets Index for Pakistan. Changes take effect from the close of Aug 31, 2026. Direct article fetch returned HTTP 403 on both Business Recorder and Bloom Pakistan; detail sourced from search-result summaries of those articles, not a direct quote - flagged for confirmation in a follow-up cycle. Logged as impact 4 (index reconstitution) per desk news-impact criteria (Rule 10); escalation flagged.

news.headline: Cement: Local demand holds the fort - FY27 dispatch data
news.summary: Business Recorder BR Research ('Cement: Local demand holds the fort') reports July 2026 cement dispatches: total industry dispatches up 6% YoY to 4.48m tons; domestic dispatches up 17.3% YoY to 3.77m tons, the strongest July performance since 2020, with the improvement coming entirely from the local market. Industry dispatches projected to grow a further 7-8% in FY27 if private construction recovery and budgeted development spending continue; sector still carries substantial idle capacity and weak household affordability. Logged as impact 3 (notable sector news with concrete monthly dispatch figures) per desk criteria, tagged to core-tier cement constituents.
